subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: What privacy-safe conversation label and estimated-versus-observed wording should OpenClaw use in user-visible context-overflow diagnostics?
rationale: The required runtime facts already exist, but raw session keys may expose channel or peer identifiers and precheck counts are estimates rather than measured provider usage; current public contracts do not settle either choice.

options.title: Safe label with qualifiers
options.body: Use an existing channel-safe presentation label and explicitly mark each token value as estimated or observed.

options.title: Omit conversation identity
options.body: Show provider/model, effective budget, overage, and recovery actions without identifying the session.

options.title: Expose internal session key
options.body: Print the raw internal session key and numeric values wherever they are available.

recommendation.title: Safe label with qualifiers
recommendation.body: Use an existing channel-safe presentation label and explicitly mark each token value as estimated or observed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership and prior review discussion most directly connect this person to the cross-path runtime behavior and product tradeoff.
